name: chat_messaging_message_post
description: Posts a message in a channel, or as a reply in a thread, as the connection's account, under our key (a post with a key already used posts nothing and gives that message). Mention a member as @<member id>; attach files uploaded with file.upload by their ids.

key.description: Our id for the message, the idempotency key

thread.description: Reply in the thread this message starts

files.description: Ids of files uploaded with file.upload
